_readme: Index of every dataset in data/. Written by scripts/build_catalog.py. provenance: pipeline = fetched by scripts/fetch.py on a schedule; script = written by another script, run by hand; manual = pulled by hand, cannot self-refresh; unattributed = nothing claims it, treat with suspicion.

datasets.source: EC agri-food data portal: young bulls R3 EU avg (EUR/100kg) + feed grain MS avg (EUR/t), monthly means of weekly quotes
TCMB EVDS / TÜİK Yİ-ÜFE: TP.TUFE1YI.T17 (korunmuş et ve et ürünleri), TP.TUFE1YI.T25 (hazır hayvan yemleri)
FRED/BLS producer price indexes: WPU0131 (slaughter cattle), WPU012202 (corn)

datasets.note: denominator = maize/corn everywhere (robustness check)

datasets.source: Euro area HICP via FRED — deflator for any EUR money series
Eurostat EAA veterinary expenses by member state, million EUR, ALL livestock
datasets.note: all livestock, not cattle only

datasets.source: Eurostat Economic Accounts for Agriculture, veterinary expenses
datasets.note: ALL livestock, not cattle only — do not present as a per-cattle figure without saying so

datasets.source: Eurostat ert_bil_eur_a — annual average exchange rates, national currency per euro
datasets.note: used only to express absolute pharma value added in a common currency; every share ratio stays in national currency

datasets.source: Eurostat national accounts — GDP at market prices, current prices, million EUR
datasets.note: for comparing economy SIZE across countries only; never use for the share ratio

datasets.source: Eurostat national accounts — GDP at market prices, current prices, million national currency
datasets.note: same vintage and currency basis as pharma-gva, so the ratio is internally consistent

datasets.source: Company filings (10-Q, 8-K), company releases, regulatory announcements and industry landscape reviews, Dec 2025 – Aug 2026
Yahoo Finance monthly adjusted closes, US listings/ADRs (USD); ^GSPC = S&P 500 index, XBI = SPDR biotech ETF benchmark
datasets.note: Adjusted close = split- and dividend-adjusted (total return); index SPX is raw level. ADRs (NVO, AZN, RHHBY, ZLDPF) embed FX moves. Metsera (MTSR) excluded: acquired by Pfizer Nov 2025, delisted — survivorship caveat. Zealand only trades OTC in the US (ZLDPF, thin); primary listing is Copenhagen.

datasets.source: Company fundamentals and consensus estimates via Bigdata.com
datasets.note: Trailing multiples are company-level and on reported earnings; consensus growth is on an adjusted basis. Basis differs by company (TTM for one, FY2025 for the rest) and is carried per row.
datasets.refresh: manual — re-pull via the Bigdata.com connector; not on the cron

datasets.source: Eurostat nasa_10_nf_tr — gross national income (B5G), total economy
datasets.note: GNI minus GDP is net primary income from abroad: negative where foreign-owned profits are repatriated out, positive where a country's firms earn abroad

datasets.source: Eurostat national accounts A*64 — total gross value added, current prices, million national currency
datasets.note: the like-for-like denominator. GDP = GVA + taxes less subsidies on products, so pharma/GVA is the cleaner share; pharma/GDP is the more quotable one.

datasets.source: FAOSTAT cattle stocks (head), via Our World in Data
datasets.note: annual; national totals, all cattle

datasets.source: FAOSTAT cattle stocks (head) by EU member state, via Our World in Data
datasets.note: dairy and beef combined, same limitation as the aggregate

datasets.note: No script writes this file and it is not in data-sources.json. Provenance unknown — verify or remove.

datasets.source: Eurostat national accounts A*64 — total manufacturing (NACE C) gross value added, current prices, million national currency
datasets.note: context denominator: pharma's share of manufacturing, not just of the whole economy

datasets.source: Comext — where Ireland's bulk peptide hormone exports go
Comext — HS 2937.19 imports (flow 1) and exports (flow 2), value and quantity
datasets.note: net exports test: re-export shows as large imports; domestic production does not

datasets.source: Destination markets for the concentration leaders, by HS4 class, 2024
Eurostat Comext DS-045409 — exports to world, EUR, by HS4: 3002 immunologicals/vaccines, 3003 bulk medicaments, 3004 dosage medicaments, 2937 hormones, 2941 antibiotics
datasets.note: EXPORTS, not production — the product-mix proxy; say so wherever shown

datasets.source: Eurostat national accounts A*64 — NACE C21 gross value added, current prices, million EUR
datasets.note: for comparing absolute pharma output across countries; the share ratio uses the MNAC pair

datasets.source: Eurostat national accounts A*64 — gross value added of NACE C21 (basic pharmaceutical products and preparations), current prices, million national currency
datasets.note: NATIONAL CURRENCY on purpose — the pharma/GDP ratio must not carry exchange-rate noise. C21 is manufacturing only: it excludes pharma wholesale, retail pharmacy and R&D services.

datasets.source: Eurostat Comext DS-045409 — exports to world by HS6 therapeutic class, 2010-2024
datasets.note: 293719 polypeptide hormones (GLP-1/insulin-analogue class, bulk); 300241 human vaccines; 300215 immunological in doses (antibodies); 300212 antisera/blood fractions; 300431 insulin medicaments; 300439 other hormone medicaments; 300490 other medicaments

datasets.source: Eurostat Comext DS-045409 — EU27 imports by partner and HS4, EUR: what non-EU producers ship into the EU
datasets.note: MIRROR data: reveals a country's export mix to the EU only, not its global mix or production

Product mix as share of pharma trade value by HS class (3002 biologics, 3004 dosage, 3003 bulk, 2937 hormones, 2941 antibiotics). Eurostat Comext DS-045409. EU/EFTA rows = exports to world; non-EU rows = exports to the EU only (mirror). Proxy for product mix, NOT production.
ISIC C21 value added as % of total-economy value added. OECD STAN DF_STAN_2025, current prices, national currency. Only countries the Eurostat set lacks or truncates.
C21 gross value added as % of GDP / total GVA / manufacturing GVA. Eurostat nama_10_a64 + nama_10_gdp, current prices, national currency.
Exports to world, EUR, 2024, Eurostat Comext DS-045409. Classes are HS 6-digit; 'not published' is the residual between the HS4 chapter total and the published detail.

datasets.source: OECD STAN — value added of ISIC C21 (pharmaceuticals), current prices, million national currency
datasets.note: same industry definition as NACE C21, so shares are comparable with the Eurostat set; national currency so the ratio carries no FX noise

datasets.source: OECD STAN — total-economy value added, current prices, million national currency
datasets.note: denominator for the STAN pharma share; same source and basis as stan-pharma so the ratio is internally consistent
